sentences.text: The petitioner is the accused in Crime No.694/2023 of Cheruthuruthy Police Station, Thrissur.

The offences alleged against him are under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 312 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
 2.
The prosecution case is that the petitioner committed rape upon the de facto complainant on 21.06.2023, and on various dates thereafter, giving the false promise of marriage to her.
It is also alleged that the de facto complainant, who got impregnated in the above relationship, was subjected to abortion at the instance of the petitioner.
3. The case has been registered by the Cheruthuruthy Police on the basis of the First Information Statement given by the de facto complainant on 06.12.2023.
4. In the present petition, the petitioner would contend that he is totally innocent, and that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
According to the petitioner, the de facto complainant has engaged in sexual relationship with him with full consent.
It is also stated that the matter has been amicably settled between them, with 2025:KER:58820 the petitioner marrying the de facto complainant.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the de facto complainant and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.
6.
The de facto complainant has filed an affidavit stating that she has no subsisting grievance as against the petitioner, since the petitioner has married her.

7. The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the de facto complainant had given statement to the Investigating Officer also, to the effect that she has no complaint against the petitioner, since he had married her, and they are leading a peaceful family life.

8. The learned counsel for the de facto complainant submitted that the continuance of the prosecution against the petitioner is totally unnecessary, since the petitioner and the de facto complainant are now leading a peaceful life as husband and wife.

The marriage certificate evidencing the marriage of the petitioner with the de facto complainant, solemnized on 26.02.2024,
is produced by the petitioner.

9. Having regard to the above facts and circumstances of 2025:KER:58820 the case, it is not possible to say that the petitioner committed rape upon the de facto complainant, or resorted to miscarriage of her pregnancy.
10. It is apparent from the records that there was consensual sexual relationship between the petitioner and the de facto complainant, and that the abortion was also done with her consent.
